newsitem.title: USA: Vectra files registration for cumulative.
newsitem.headline: Vectra files registration for cumulative.

text.p: Vectra Banking Corporation said it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed offering of $17.5 million of cumulative capital securities by VBC Capital I, a Delaware business trust subsidiary of Vectra Banking Corporation.

The offering will be made through Dain Bosworth Incorporated and Howe Barnes Investments Inc. Vectra Banking Corporation intends to use approximately $8.3 million of the net proceeds of the offering to redeem its outstanding $0.95 Series A cumulative preferred stock.
